caption: The scene is a modern, futuristic startup office, rendered in a realistic style with a warm and inviting tone, emphasizing comfort and innovation. The office features sleek, minimalist furniture and advanced technology integrated seamlessly into the design. Large panoramic windows offer a breathtaking view of a sprawling, futuristic city skyline, with towering skyscrapers and illuminated pathways stretching into the distance. Numerous potted plants are strategically placed throughout the space, adding vibrant touches of greenery and enhancing the biophilic design. The lighting is predominantly warm, emanating from recessed ceiling fixtures and ambient strip lights, creating a soft, welcoming glow. Desks are equipped with holographic displays and ergonomic chairs, suggesting a high-tech yet comfortable work environment. A central communal area includes comfortable seating arrangements and a large interactive display screen. The walls are finished in smooth, light-colored materials, contrasting with darker accents and metallic finishes on furniture and fixtures. The floor is a polished, light-toned material, reflecting the ambient light and contributing to the open feel of the space. The panoramic windows span an entire wall, providing an unobstructed view of the city. Potted plants are situated on desks, shelves, and in corners, creating natural focal points. The communal seating area is positioned centrally, facing the large interactive display. The 360 scene is faultless.
